items.summary: Base editing biotech Beam Therapeutics is suing one of its newest rivals, alleging that the upstart company stole the secrets behind one of its lead programs and used them to craft a competing therapy.

items.title: Gilead partners with Calm to roll out disease-specific emotional wellness support
items.summary: Sleep app Calm is helping Gilead achieve its dream of helping its patients through a journey of whole-person health.

items.title: Shionogi strikes $2B deal for IntraBio hot off FDA label expansion
items.summary: The acquisition builds on Shionogi’s plans to diversify beyond its anti-infectious disease drug base and to beef up its budding rare disease unit.

items.title: Evolving Patient Support Programs: Clinical Support as Competitive Advantage
items.summary: For biopharmaceutical commercial teams, integrating clinical support into Patient Support Programs (PSPs) is becoming a competitive advantage for differentiating complex therapies in crowded markets.

items.title: The Future of Healthcare Marketing Isn’t More Media. It’s Better Intelligence.
items.summary: Healthcare marketers have never had more ways to reach an audience.

items.title: For biopharma manufacturing at speed and scale, the future is flexible
items.summary: Biopharma development has long trended toward specialized and personalized therapies such as cell and gene therapies, antibody-drug conjugates, and monoclonal antibodies (mAbs), among others.

items.title: BridgeBio taps Hip Hop Public Health and others up to put a new beat on ATTR-CM awareness
items.summary: BridgeBio's YouTube awareness push to lead up to World Amyloidosis Day features a conversation with Hip Hop Public Health's Doug E. Fresh and more.

items.title: FDA dings Evolus for blurring the lines between Botox rival and lipstick
items.summary: The FDA has warned Evolus over an Instagram reel that made the “especially problematic” suggestion of blurred lines between a prescription product and consumer cosmetics.

items.title: With FDA approval, Lilly’s BTK drug Jaypirca enters first-line CLL
items.summary: Eli Lilly’s Jaypirca, the first noncovalent BTK inhibitor, has won FDA approval for the first-line treatment of chronic lymphocytic leukemia or small lymphocytic lymphoma, a market now led by BeOne’s Brukinsa.

items.title: 'The best is yet to come': Bayer doubles down on US with plans for $2.2B Ohio manufacturing site
items.summary: Following a spate of large-scale pharma investments in the U.S. last year, German conglomerate Bayer is advancing its own plans to expand in America, in a move the company is framing as the culmination of a multi-year strategy, rather than an acute policy response.

items.title: HRSA names 10 drugmakers for revised 340B rebate pilot ahead of 2027 launch
items.summary: The list of approved participants and drugs is larger than the controversial pilot's first attempted launch. It comes the same day that CMS launched a soon-to-be-mandatory data repository for Part D 340B claim submissions.

items.title: Pfizer touts 'dermatology momentum' as it paints fuller picture of Litfulo's vitiligo potential
items.summary: Pfizer has detailed two clinical wins for its immunology portfolio as it aims for a label expansion, an approval and new indications beyond dermatology, too.

items.title: Locking in on pharma’s consumerization trend
items.summary: With GLP-1s paving the way, a consumer shift is happening across markets for certain branded pharmaceuticals. Now, the CEO of a buzzy pattern-hair-loss biotech is eyeing opportunities in an evolving market that could expand well beyond his own company.

items.title: The Oral GLP-1 Tracker: Lilly's Foundayo surges as Novo's Wegovy pill stalls
items.summary: Fierce Pharma is launching the weekly Oral GLP-1 Tracker, leveraging analysts’ notes and IQVIA data to monitor prescription trends and shifting market shares as Novo Nordisk's Wegovy pill and Eli Lilly's Foundayo vie to become the go-to oral weight-loss solution for millions.

items.title: Regulatory tracker: FDA green lights Camzyos in kids; J&J blocks Simponi biosimilars
items.summary: In this tracker, Fierce Pharma is recording the regulatory progress of in-market products, including expansions into key geographies and new indications. Some of these updates may not meet the bar for standalone stories, but we think they are still worth mentioning.

items.title: Teva, Samsung Bioepis deepen bonds in pact for up to 6 new biosimilars
items.summary: Already sharing the load on two biosimilar assets, Teva Pharmaceutical and Samsung Bioepis have elected to take their partnership to the next level.

items.title: Fierce Pharma Asia—AZ’s $2B bet on ivonescimab; Novo buys Hengrui GLP-1; Merck doubles down on KRAS
items.summary: In three deals each worth $2 billion or more, AstraZeneca is investing in Summit Therapeutics with a focus on ivonescimab, Novo bought a preclinical GLP-1/GIP drug from Hengrui Pharma, while Merck & Co. got a preclinical RAS(ON) inhibitor from China's SciBrunch. And more.

items.title: It's 'About Damn Time' to highlight the post-treatment breast cancer journey, Genentech says in new campaign
items.summary: "About Damn Time" focuses on the journey following initial treatment for HR-positive, HER2-negative early breast cancer, when patients turn to preventing recurrence.

items.title: Lilly gives deeper glimpse at Foundayo's heart-helping odds in diabetes, obesity phase 3
items.summary: In a new update, Lilly tied Foundayo to a 53% reduction in the risk of cardiovascular death and a 57% lower risk of all-cause mortality compared with insulin glargine in a preplanned analysis of its phase 3 Achieve-4 trial.

items.title: Taiho scores phase 3 win with oral cancer combo for AML-causing blood disorders
items.summary: The oral combination treatment delivered the same exposure to azacitidine as when the chemo was given subcutaneously—meeting Taiho’s primary endpoint.

items.title: Johnson & Johnson survey finds women not connecting menopause to eye health changes
items.summary: Hot flashes, mood and sleep disturbances are common themes for menopause: But vision changes are not one that makes the list of common symptoms. Now, J&J is looking to highlight this often-overlooked issue.

items.title: Real Chemistry launches AI-powered MaestroHCP to conduct omnichannel campaigns
items.summary: Real Chemistry has created an artificial intelligence-enabled platform to improve a manual, fragmented stage of the omnichannel marketing process.

items.title: Asahi Kasei wraps years of global dealmaking into a single brand
items.summary: After years of deal-driven global expansion, Asahi Kasei is rolling its pharma units up under a single brand and forging ahead with efforts to drive sales toward $2 billion by the end of the decade.

items.title: CMS finalizes model that aims to bring most-favored nation pricing to Part B
items.summary: The Trump administration has finalized a new model that aims to bring its most-favored nation pricing approach to Medicare Part B.

items.title: Organon beams up 'Skin Science' in sci-fi themed Vtama campaign
items.summary: Organon leaned into non-steriod skin cream Vtama's first-in-class status for a science-fiction themed HCP marketing campaign, complete with aliens and UFOs.
